texts.en: The archaeological expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] has been forced to take precautions against radiation poisoning due to the high levels of radioactivity on the ruined planet. However, it seems that a leak has caused a significant scare on the site where the archaeologists were excavating. [Root.Leader.GetName] and [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] team have had to pause excavations until radiation can be restored to safe levels.

# 辐射泄露 / Radiation Leak
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 考古插曲 archaeological interlude
- 来源 Sources：`events/federations_events_2.txt:501-524` · `common/scripted_effects/archaeology_event_effects.txt`

## 如何开始 How it starts

考古遗址阶段检定失败时（standard_archaeological_site_on_roll_failed）进入多个遗址的随机事件池（如“沙拉什废墟”“Zroni/Grunur 挖掘点”等），池内权重 10 之一；一次性（遗址旗标）。/ Drawn from the random-event pools of several archaeological sites when a stage roll fails.

单事件。/ A single event.

无。/ None.
